name: Do I need a building permit for a room addition in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a room addition in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, virtually all residential room additions require building permits from your local municipality or county building department. Because additions involve structural framing, foundation work, and mechanical systems like electrical and plumbing, local building officials must review plans and conduct staged inspections. In the Denver metro area, including communities like Centennial and Parker, plans must meet regional building codes before construction begins. HH Remodeling acts as your single point of contact, helping coordinate required permits and scheduling sub-trades for electrical and plumbing inspections alongside our framing and carpentry work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, room additions require municipal building permits and inspections for structural framing, foundations, and mechanical work like plumbing and electrical.
